sources: Confluence space AI (Control Plane positioning, Coworker definition, Runbooks)

test_cases.prompt: I need to prototype the ACP Trust-Level Model UI that shows MSPs how their confidence score is calculated. Pull from the Control Plane positioning doc in Confluence (space AI) and the Coworker definition doc. Show it as an overlay in N-central using Apex Bridge. This is directional fidelity (Tier 2) — we're testing whether surfacing the math behind the trust level actually builds confidence or just creates cognitive load.
expected_outputs: scout_input/ with 2-3 docs from Confluence AI space (Control Plane, Coworker, possibly Runbooks)
briefs/acp-trust-level.brief.md with 40-60% [A]+[?] ratio (appropriate for Tier 2)
critic-pass-1.md with pre-build scores (expect 3-4 range on most dimensions)
prototypes/acp-trust-level/index.html with Apex Bridge overlay, Tier 2 fidelity banner, Bradley rail
critic-pass-2.md with post-build scores + delta (expect demo-ability to improve)
council-testimony.md with JTBD and Service Blueprint potentially contradicting on math visibility
briefs/handoffs/nicole-acp-trust-level-[date]/ with complete packet
success_criteria: Apex Bridge overlay pattern renders correctly (slide-in from right or modal)
Bradley rail Product card shows 60-80% Nicole attribution with reasoning
Council explicitly names JTBD vs. Service Blueprint tension on transparency (if present)
Handoff packet includes attribution matrix showing calculation for Product card
test_cases.notes: Nicole authored the source docs. Tone should be peer-to-peer, ACP-internal. Don't re-explain Coworkers/Runbooks to Nicole.

test_cases.prompt: Show me what the ACP Value Ledger looks like when an MSP is reviewing their monthly usage and cost breakdown. I want to see the 5 monetization layers visualized. Use the Runbooks doc from Confluence for context on what actions get metered. Apex Bridge delivery, concept-level (Tier 1) — this is exploratory, so high [A] ratio is expected. Run full council to see if JTBD and Value Chain agree on whether we should show the math or hide it.
expected_outputs: scout_input/ with Runbooks doc from Confluence AI space
briefs/acp-value-ledger.brief.md with 50-70% [A]+[?] ratio (appropriate for Tier 1 / Concept)
critic-pass-1.md flagging high [A] ratio but noting it's appropriate for Tier 1
prototypes/acp-value-ledger/index.html with 5 monetization layers visualized, Apex Bridge overlay, Tier 1 fidelity banner
critic-pass-2.md with post-build scores
council-testimony.md with JTBD and Value Chain potentially contradicting on transparency, plus other voices
briefs/handoffs/nicole-acp-value-ledger-[date]/ with complete packet routing the visibility decision to Nicole
success_criteria: Spec explicitly flags high [A]+[?] ratio but proceeds (appropriate for Tier 1)
Council runs all 5 frameworks (not just JTBD and Value Chain)
If JTBD and Value Chain contradict on visibility, handoff routes this as a decision to Nicole
Bradley rail includes 'Unknown: gap' in ROI section where appropriate
test_cases.notes: Tier 1 / Concept means exploration is the goal. High [A] ratio is expected and should not block. Council emphasis means the expert voices are the primary deliverable here.

test_cases.prompt: Prototype the Coworker handoff screen — when an MSP escalates from AI Coworker to human Runbook expert. Pull from both the Coworker doc and Runbooks doc in Confluence. This needs to be spec-ready (Tier 3) so the [A] ratio should be under 30%. Show what context the human expert sees when they receive the handoff. Apex Bridge overlay. Include ownership attribution on any AI-generated elements.
expected_outputs: scout_input/ with Coworker doc + Runbooks doc from Confluence AI space
briefs/acp-coworker-handoff.brief.md with <30% [A]+[?] ratio (Tier 3 requirement)
critic-pass-1.md noting whether spec meets Tier 3 threshold
prototypes/acp-coworker-handoff/index.html with context transfer UI, Apex Bridge overlay, Tier 3 fidelity banner, attribution on AI-generated elements
critic-pass-2.md validating attribution display is present and correct
council-testimony.md with Service Blueprint voice analyzing frontstage/backstage handoff
briefs/handoffs/nicole-acp-coworker-handoff-[date]/ with complete packet + attribution matrix
success_criteria: [A]+[?] ratio is <30% OR spec flags readiness issue and asks whether to proceed
Prototype shows context transfer from AI to human clearly
Ownership attribution displays on any AI-generated suggestions/context (e.g., '0% Nicole' for tool-generated summary)
Bradley rail includes attribution reasoning for key components
Handoff packet includes attribution matrix showing calculations for multiple components
Service Blueprint voice in council explicitly analyzes the handoff visibility
test_cases.notes: Tier 3 means this should be build-ready. If [A]+[?] is >30%, spec should flag and confirm before proceeding. Attribution is emphasized — test that the skill correctly applies and displays X% Nicole throughout.

validation_notes: All test cases use Confluence space AI as primary source — Nicole has access
All test cases use Apex Bridge delivery — Bryce Wilson's overlay pattern
All test cases include Bradley rail and council by default
Attribution emphasis varies by test case — Tier 3 test specifically validates display
Fidelity levels span Tier 1/2/3 to test threshold logic at each gate
